name: The Gambia
summary: Red, blue and green horizontal bands, with the blue edged in white. The blue band represents the Gambia River, which runs through the length of this narrow country.
origin: The flag was designed by Louis Thomasi, an accountant, and adopted at independence from Britain on 18 February 1965. It avoids the colours of any political party.
facts: The Gambia is almost entirely surrounded by Senegal.
It is the smallest country on mainland Africa.
clues: Red, white-edged blue, and green horizontal bands.
Its blue band is a river running through a narrow country.
Its country is almost entirely surrounded by one neighbour.
